answer: Ricky Serna informed Annette Rodriguez that she was not approved to teach and would not be teaching at the college anymore, effectively terminating her employment. Rodriguez believed Serna, as vice president of advancement, was making academic hiring decisions outside of his authority, which conflicted with her perspective that full-time faculty members should make such decisions.
